paragraphs: Valarian Technologies is a dual-use technology company building critical tools to safeguard the future in an era of evolving global security challenges. You are looking for an experienced Senior MLOps / LLMOps Engineer to lead the deployment, monitoring, orchestration, and operational reliability of your production LLM applications and agentic AI platform. In this role you will bridge the gap between AI development and production infrastructure, ensuring multi‑step agentic workflows, data pipelines and retrieval‑augmented systems run reliably, securely and at scale within a large‑scale Kubernetes environment.

I have spent several years designing and operating agentic pipelines that integrate large language models with custom tooling. Using Python I built end‑to‑end workflows that orchestrate tool execution and prompt chaining, storing intermediate state in PostgreSQL and coordinating releases through CI pipelines. My experience includes configuring GitHub Actions to automate container builds, run regression suites and roll out blue/green deployments, guaranteeing that each LLM service remains available while new features are introduced. This background aligns directly with your requirement for llm expertise, agentic workflow management and GitHub Actions automation.

I have also led evaluation projects that apply machine‑learning techniques to predict churn and optimise propensity models. Leveraging XGBoost within an R environment I performed extensive hyperparameter tuning to improve predictive accuracy, then validated results against held‑out data sets. The resulting evaluation framework delivered clear metrics on model performance and informed iterative improvements, satisfying your need for rigorous evaluation and strong machine‑learning capability.
